card.name: Small words in repeated label sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "with" and "or" inside fixed label sentences, mostly "Prescriptions ... should be written for the smallest quantity consistent with good patient management". Also "security" in a HIPAA Security Rule sentence.

modes.label: Smallest quantity prescribing sentence
